title: Retrospektive Eth Zurich Met New York
main_content:
Building on Zurich’s role as a 21st-century hub for scientific and technological innovation, Zürich Meets New York: A Festival of Swiss Ingenuity took place from 16 to 23 May 2014. It highlighted the contemporary relevance of visionary movements and ideas born in Zurich and their impact on American culture. The festival featured more than 25 events, 11 of which were hosted by ETH Zurich and its partners at venues across New York City. The retrospect, ETH Zurich Met New York will look back at ETH Zurich’s public appearance in New York City as part of the Zürich Meets New York festival. A festive setting will feature photographs, poster column designs and videos, showcasing ETH Zurich’s contribution to the Zürich Meets New York festival.

ETH Zurich Met New York 22 July – 12 August 2014 Main Hall

ETH Zurich Rämistrasse 101 8092 Zurich
